faq.a1: VIP membership gives you unlimited access to all exclusive cosplay photo albums, high-resolution downloads, and early access to new content.
faq.q2: How long does VIP membership last?
faq.a2: VIP membership is available in 1-month, 3-month, and 12-month plans. Your access continues until the end of your chosen period.
faq.q3: Can I cancel my VIP membership?
faq.a3: Yes, you can cancel anytime. Your VIP access will remain active until the end of your current billing period.
faq.a4: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and other payment methods via our secure payment processor.
faq.a5: Yes, all payments are processed securely. We never store your card details on our servers.

about.pageDesc: Learn about Yukvix, our mission to celebrate cosplay as art, and the values that guide everything we do.
about.heroDesc: Yukvix was founded with a simple mission: to create the most beautiful and curated destination for cosplay photography on the internet.
about.missionP1: We believe cosplay is a legitimate art form that deserves a dedicated, high-quality platform. Our mission is to connect talented cosplay artists with fans who appreciate their craft.
about.missionP2: Yukvix provides a premium gallery platform where cosplay photographers and artists can showcase their work. We offer both free and VIP membership tiers, giving fans access to exclusive high-resolution content.
about.valuesSubtitle: These principles guide every decision we make, from curation to community management.
about.value1Desc: We curate only the highest quality cosplay photography, ensuring every image meets our rigorous standards.
about.value2Desc: All creators are properly credited and compensated. We believe in fair partnerships with the artists we feature.
about.value3Desc: We foster a respectful, inclusive community of cosplay enthusiasts from all backgrounds and fandoms.
about.value4Desc: We protect the privacy of our users and creators with industry-standard security practices.
about.ctaDesc: Browse thousands of stunning cosplay photos from talented creators worldwide.

info.pageDesc: Learn about Yukvix platform features, content standards, and technical information.
info.heroDesc: Yukvix is a premium cosplay photography gallery platform dedicated to showcasing high-quality cosplay art from talented creators worldwide.
info.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to enjoy and discover cosplay photography.
info.feat1Desc: Browse thousands of stunning cosplay photos in full resolution, organized by creator, fandom, and character.
info.feat2Desc: Unlock exclusive premium content, high-res downloads, and early access to new galleries with a VIP subscription.
info.feat3Desc: Find exactly what you're looking for with powerful filters by character, series, creator, and content type.
info.feat4Desc: VIP members can download entire albums as ZIP files for offline viewing and personal collections.
info.feat5Desc: Your data is protected with industry-standard encryption. We never share your personal information.
info.feat6Desc: Subscribe with credit card via Stripe. Cancel anytime with no hidden fees or lock-in periods.
info.contentStandardsDesc: All content on Yukvix is carefully curated to maintain the highest quality standards. We work directly with creators to ensure proper licensing and attribution.
info.standard1: All creators are verified and credited
info.standard3: DMCA takedown requests are processed promptly
info.techInfoDesc: Yukvix is built with modern web technologies to deliver a fast, secure, and reliable experience across all devices.
info.availableDesc: Yukvix is accessible from any country. Content is delivered via CDN for fast loading regardless of your location.
